nodes.text: Does God exist?
Is Trump intelligent?
Do animals employ language?
Donald Trump won the 2016 and 2024 United States presidential elections against experienced professional politicians.
Donald Trump's now-defunct Trump University paid $25 million in a 2016 settlement following fraud allegations from former students.
The physical constants of the universe, such as the cosmological constant and the strong nuclear force strength, fall within the narrow ranges required for the formation of stable atoms and stars.
Natural disasters and diseases inflict severe suffering on innocent children and animals with no discernible morally sufficient reason.
Bonobos and chimpanzees trained in lexigram systems such as Kanzi combined symbols to request specific items in captive laboratory studies.
Trained chimpanzees and gorillas such as Nim Chimpsky and Koko combined signs in random order without consistent syntactic structure in published analyses of their sign transcripts.
Donald Trump earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School in 1968.
Donald Trump stated in a July 2019 speech that American forces during the Revolutionary War “took over the airports.”
Japanese tits in playback experiments approached speakers more frequently after natural alarm–recruitment call sequences than after reversed sequences.
In Terrace and colleagues’ 1979 study, most of Nim Chimpsky’s signed utterances followed prompts from human trainers.
Donald Trump won the 2016 Republican primary against a field of 16 other candidates, several with decades of elected political experience.
Donald Trump lost the 2020 United States presidential election to Joe Biden, an experienced professional politician.
Airports did not exist during the Revolutionary War of 1775 to 1783, and Trump's July 2019 speech occurred amid teleprompter malfunctions and heavy rain.
Donald Trump built a real estate and branding business that Forbes estimated to be worth billions of dollars as of the 2020s.
Donald Trump refused to release his academic transcripts throughout his 2016 and 2024 presidential campaigns.
Researchers analyzing videotapes of Koko the gorilla's sign combinations in the 1980s found frequent repetition of single signs rather than novel multi-sign constructions.
Patricia Marks Greenfield and Heidi Lyn's reanalyses of Nim Chimpsky's sign transcripts identified position preferences for certain sign combinations consistent with rudimentary grammatical rules.
Christian, Muslim, and Hindu mystics have reported experiences of direct contact with a divine presence.
Some sincere seekers of God remain unconvinced of God's existence despite sustained efforts to find God.
Japanese tits produced a visual scanning behavior for predators only after hearing the natural alarm-recruitment sequence in the 2020 Suzuki and Matsudaira playback experiments.
In the Suzuki 2018 Japanese tit playback study, sample sizes per condition were fewer than 20 birds, limiting statistical power to detect approach-rate differences.
The bonobo Kanzi produced novel two-symbol lexigram combinations not explicitly taught by researchers during testing sessions at the Language Research Center in the 1980s and 1990s.
Researchers analyzing Nim Chimpsky's and other apes' multi-symbol sequences found that most combinations lacked consistent word order compared to human syntax.
Vervet monkeys in Amboseli National Park use acoustically distinct alarm calls that cause other vervets to perform different, predator-specific escape responses.
No non-human animal signaling system in the wild has been documented to exhibit recursive syntactic embedding as of 2026.
Donald Trump scored 30/30 on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment in 2018, according to White House physician Ronny Jackson.
Six of Donald Trump's hotel and casino businesses filed for bankruptcy protection between 1991 and 2009.
Donald Trump received 312 electoral votes to incumbent Vice President Kamala Harris’s 226 in the 2024 United States presidential election.
Hillary Clinton received nearly 2.9 million more popular votes than Donald Trump in the 2016 United States presidential election.
Nim Chimpsky’s mean signed utterance length showed no sustained increase with age in Terrace and colleagues’ 1979 analysis.
Suzuki and colleagues’ 2016 Japanese tit playback experiment used the same call components in natural-order and reversed-order stimuli.
The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami killed more than 30,000 children under age 15 within hours.
Soul-building through exposure to natural evils in childhood can produce compensating virtues such as compassion and courage that free will alone cannot generate.
The chimpanzee Lana used the lexigram sequence “please machine give juice” to obtain juice from an automated dispenser during 1970s experiments.
Every known effect in the observable universe has a prior cause, forming a causal chain that cannot regress infinitely.
Historical and archaeological research derives the core narratives of the Torah, the Gospels, and the Quran from earlier Near Eastern myths and oral traditions.
The official White House transcript of Donald Trump’s July 4, 2019 “Salute to America” address includes the phrase “took over the airports.”
A perfect score on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment indicates no signs of cognitive impairment in the person tested.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment is designed to screen for dementia and cognitive impairment rather than to measure general intelligence.
A change of only a few percent in the strong nuclear force strength would prevent stable formation of carbon and oxygen inside stars.
Physicists have calculated stable atoms and stars form under a wide range of alternative physical constant combinations in multiverse models such as those explored by Fred Adams in 2008.
Western honeybee foragers encode the locations of food sources beyond hive mates’ immediate sensory range in waggle dances performed inside hives.
Greenfield and Lyn's 1974–1976 Nim Chimpsky transcript reanalysis found that two-sign combinations involving 'more' placed the sign first significantly more often than chance.
Nim Chimpsky's position preferences identified by Greenfield and Lyn occurred at rates consistent with reinforced habit patterns rather than grammatical rule-following.

Researchers Savage-Rumbaugh and colleagues reported that Kanzi combined the lexigrams for a known food with an action symbol in configurations absent from his training records during testing sessions in the 1980s.
Researchers Sue Savage-Rumbaugh and colleagues did not publish frequency counts distinguishing spontaneous novel lexigram combinations from trained sequences in their 1980s Kanzi reports.
A Centrosaurus dinosaur living approximately 76 million years ago developed advanced bone cancer in a lower leg.
Preserving predictable natural laws for meaningful human agency provides a moral justification for permitting natural hazards affecting children and animals.
Torturing children for amusement is morally wrong independently of any person's beliefs or social conventions.
Donald Trump built a media and entertainment career hosting the television show 'The Apprentice' for 14 seasons from 2004 to 2015.
Intercessory prayer did not reduce postoperative complications among coronary bypass patients in the 2006 STEP randomized trial.

Donald Trump repeatedly mispronounced or confused basic terms, such as referring to 'origins' as 'oranges' and misstating the name of his own country's document 'the Constitution' in various public remarks.
White House physician Ronny Jackson personally administered Donald Trump’s Montreal Cognitive Assessment during the president’s January 2018 medical examination.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment screens for cognitive impairment rather than measuring intelligence.

Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler's 1980 playback experiments found vervet monkeys at Amboseli responded to recorded leopard, eagle, and snake alarm calls with the same escape response elicited by live predator sightings, in the absence of any actual predator.
Vervet monkey alarm calls in Amboseli National Park lack the combinatorial syntax required by linguists' definitions of language.
With other cosmological parameters fixed, a sufficiently large positive cosmological constant prevents the gravitational collapse required for galaxy formation.
Hydrogen fusion through the proton–proton chain requires no carbon or oxygen nuclei.
In Karl von Frisch's decoding experiments, the angle of the waggle run on the vertical comb corresponded to the direction of a feeding site relative to the sun's azimuth.
In Michael Wenner and James Gould's 1990s displacement experiments, recruited bees sometimes searched near the hive rather than at the distance and direction indicated by the dance.
Herbert Terrace and colleagues’ 1979 videotape analysis documented teacher prompting immediately before most of Nim Chimpsky’s sign utterances.
Kanzi attended Matata’s lexigram training sessions at the Language Research Center in the early 1980s before researchers documented Kanzi’s spontaneous symbol use.
Physicists have found no confirmed instance of an actual infinite regress of physical causes in the observable universe's causal history.
Quantum vacuum fluctuations in modern physics produce virtual particle pairs without any prior deterministic cause.
Donald Trump oversaw the 1986 renovation of New York City's Wollman Rink for less than the city's allocated $3 million budget.
During an April 2020 White House briefing, Donald Trump proposed investigating disinfectant injections into the body as a treatment for COVID-19.
Consistent physical laws allow humans to form reliable predictions about cause and effect when planning actions.
An omnipotent being can grant humans predictable natural laws for agency while removing the subset of natural hazards that harm only young children and animals incapable of moral choice.
Campbell's monkey alarm call sequences studied through 2023 combine suffixes and call order but show no evidence of hierarchical phrase embedding.
Campbell's monkeys in the Tai Forest combine alarm calls with a suffix in ways analyzed as compositional rule-governed structure in a 2009 study.
Neurologically immature infants lack the cognitive capacity to develop moral virtues from suffering caused by disease or disaster.
Animals lacking rational moral agency cannot receive compensating virtues such as compassion or courage from suffering caused by natural disasters.
In Karl von Frisch’s feeder experiments, western honeybees’ waggle-run duration increased with the distance between the hive and the feeder.
In Srinivasan and colleagues’ tunnel experiments, western honeybees signaled exaggerated flight distances after short flights through narrow, textured tunnels.
In Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler’s Amboseli observations, adult vervets directed eagle alarms at predatory birds more selectively than infant vervets.
Bottlenose dolphins in Sarasota Bay develop individually distinctive signature whistles that other dolphins copy to address or refer to a specific individual.
Vervet monkey alarm calls in Amboseli National Park lack a fixed grammatical arrangement that would combine two or more calls into a novel meaning.
Human responsibility for protecting children and animals from natural hazards requires a genuine possibility of failing to prevent harm.
Nonhuman animals experienced disease and injury for millions of years before humans existed.

Trump stated at the April 23, 2020 White House coronavirus task force briefing that an injection of disinfectant inside the body could knock out the virus in a minute, and asked Dr. Deborah Birx to check into it.
Donald Trump stated during the April 2020 briefing that he was speaking sarcastically to reporters about the disinfectant comment.
Past-directed null geodesics with positive average cosmic expansion have finite affine lengths under the Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem.
In the Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler 1980 playback trials, snake alarm calls caused vervet monkeys to look down into the grass around them.
In Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler's 1980 playback experiments, vervet monkeys habituated and showed weaker escape responses to repeated presentations of the same alarm call.
Objective moral duties that bind all human beings across cultures exist in every documented human society.
Independent brain-imaging studies attribute reported mystical experiences of a divine presence to identifiable neurological activity in the temporal lobes.
A being with unlimited power faces no trade-off between mutually exclusive outcomes when selecting which physical events occur.
Natural hazards such as earthquakes and infectious pathogens lack any mechanism that discriminates between victims by age or species.
Fossil evidence documents malignant bone cancer in dinosaurs millions of years before humans existed.
The human immune system’s capacity to resist infections results partly from natural selection imposed by infectious diseases over many generations.
The predicted decay times of individual radioactive atoms in quantum mechanics are described only by probability distributions, not by deterministic prior causes.
Quantum vacuum fluctuations are governed by deterministic quantum field equations, such as the Schrödinger and Dirac equations, even though individual outcomes are probabilistic.
In Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler’s 1980 Amboseli playback experiments, vervet monkeys responded to recorded leopard alarms by running into trees.
Donald Trump directed the April 23, 2020 disinfectant-treatment questions toward Department of Homeland Security official William Bryan at the White House briefing.
The African grey parrot Alex correctly answered spoken questions about similarities and differences between objects’ colors, shapes, or materials in laboratory experiments.
In von Frisch's experiments, trained bees consistently located feeding dishes placed at the direction indicated by artificial waggle-dance angles decoded by observers.
In von Frisch's decoding experiments, feeding stations were placed at a limited number of fixed compass directions rather than sampled across the full 360-degree range.

Mystics across independent religious traditions with no contact between them describe strikingly similar phenomenological features of their reported experiences, such as ineffability and a sense of unity.
Mystical experiences reported by Christian, Muslim, and Hindu mystics describe divine presences with mutually contradictory theological characteristics across the three traditions.
Physical phenomena ranging from planetary orbits to electromagnetic waves obey compact mathematical laws.
The diversity of life on Earth developed through evolutionary processes operating over billions of years.
Deterministic laws assigning different effects to different biological ages remain predictable given complete initial conditions.
Universal protection of young children from natural harm eliminates the life-or-death stakes of adults’ decisions about children’s exposure to natural hazards.
Sue Savage-Rumbaugh and colleagues published Kanzi's lexigram combination data in peer-reviewed journals in the late 1980s and early 1990s.
Researchers did not systematically cross-check Kanzi's testing-session lexigram combinations against complete records of every combination modeled by caregivers in daily interactions.
The electromagnetic vacuum state has nonzero variance in electric-field measurements even at zero temperature.
Virtual particles in perturbative quantum field theory represent internal lines in Feynman diagrams rather than directly observable particle-creation events.
Mathematicians classify actual infinities as inconsistent with construction by successive addition, per standard treatments of transfinite set theory.
Radioactive decay of individual atomic nuclei occurs at random times with no identifiable triggering event, as described by quantum mechanics.

Captive bottlenose dolphins in a 2013 Sarasota Bay study increased signal production after hearing a computer-generated copy of an unfamiliar dolphin's signature whistle played back through an underwater speaker.
Signature whistles in Sarasota Bay dolphins primarily encode individual identity information rather than functioning as arbitrary symbolic labels detached from the caller's own vocal signature.
Teresa of Ávila’s autobiography, The Life of Teresa of Jesus, records first-person accounts of visions of Jesus Christ.
Alex the parrot's trainer Irene Pepperberg used a training procedure involving repetition and modeling rather than testing spontaneous novel language use.
Non-human animals lack the capacity for second-order reflection on their own suffering required to transform it into character traits.
Wild animals that survive predator attacks and natural disasters exhibit measurable stress-resilience and adaptive behavioral changes in subsequent encounters.
In Karl von Frisch’s fixed-feeder experiments, honeybees’ waggle-run angles changed throughout the day in step with changes in the sun’s azimuth.
Honeybee waggle dances on vertical combs exhibit systematic angular deviations from sun-relative feeder bearings at intermediate dance angles, a phenomenon called residual misdirection.
Vervet monkeys at Amboseli National Park produce acoustically distinguishable alarm calls for leopards, eagles, and snakes that human observers can reliably classify by ear.

Cheney and Seyfarth's field observations at Amboseli National Park found individual vervet monkeys sometimes gave leopard alarm calls in response to non-predator disturbances such as approaching humans or other monkey groups.
Einstein’s static cosmological solution to general relativity contains timelike worldlines extending infinitely into the past.
Adults who survived serious childhood illness or family bereavement report higher levels of empathy and resilience in surveys of post-traumatic growth.
Infants and animals that die from natural disasters or disease have no subsequent life in which to exhibit any resulting virtue.
Researchers recorded signature-whistle copying between closely bonded Sarasota Bay bottlenose dolphins, including mother–calf pairs and male alliance partners.
King and Janik’s 2013 bottlenose dolphin playback experiments did not test reference to absent third-party individuals.
In Irene Pepperberg’s same–different experiments, the African grey parrot Alex answered questions about novel object pairs at above-chance rates.
The human questioners in Alex the African grey parrot’s similarity-and-difference tests knew the correct answers during testing.
The Borde-Guth-Vilenkin theorem of 2003 proves that any universe with an average expansion rate above zero cannot be past-eternal.
Quantum vacuum fluctuations in current physics models are described as uncaused events at the subatomic level.
Animals killed by natural disasters have no remaining biological lifespan for learning from painful experiences.
Rats previously exposed to soaking freed soaked companions faster than rats without soaking experience in Sato and colleagues’ 2015 laboratory study.
In von Frisch's feeder experiments, waggle-run duration increased by roughly 75 milliseconds for each additional 100 meters of distance between the hive and the feeder.
Researchers in replications of von Frisch's feeder experiments found that waggle-run duration correlated more closely with flight time than with linear distance to the feeder.
In von Frisch's fixed-feeder trials, when foragers were prevented from seeing the sun directly, their waggle-run angles still shifted to match the sun's calculated azimuth over the day.
In some of von Frisch's fixed-feeder trials, observers recorded waggle-run angles only at a few discrete times of day rather than continuously tracking azimuth change.
Infant vervets in Seyfarth, Cheney, and Marler’s Amboseli observations gave eagle alarms to a broader range of bird species than adult vervets.
Fred Adams's 2008 study found that stellar nuclear fusion remains possible across several orders of magnitude of variation in the gravitational and fine-structure constants.
Fred Adams' 2008 models still exclude the vast majority of possible fundamental constant combinations from supporting stable, long-lived stars.
Wild bottlenose dolphin mothers in Sarasota Bay produce a signature-whistle-like call more often when separated from their own calves than when reunited with them, in a study published in 2006.
In the 2013 Sarasota Bay playback study, dolphins responded similarly to copies of their own signature whistle and to copies of other individuals' signature whistles.
Non-human animals show no evidence of narrative autobiographical memory that integrates past pain into a self-concept, according to comparative cognition research.
Chimpanzees and elephants display grief-related behavior changes and altered social bonding after witnessing the death of group members.
A child's practice of courage during painful medical treatment requires confronting genuine distress beyond the child's voluntary control.
Adult survivors of childhood cancer have higher rates of post-traumatic stress symptoms than their siblings.
The standard ΛCDM cosmological model assigns the universe a finite age of approximately 13.8 billion years.
Karl von Frisch’s distance experiments used individually marked honeybees trained to follow a feeding station moved progressively farther from the hive.
In von Frisch’s experiments on sunlit horizontal combs, honeybees oriented waggle runs toward the feeding site regardless of the sun’s position.
Among the children killed in the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, many drowned or were fatally injured within minutes of the waves striking coastal villages in Indonesia, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.
Estimates of children under 15 killed by the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami vary widely across relief agencies and academic studies.
Harnik, Kribs, and Perez’s weakless-universe model contains fusion-powered stars with billion-year lifetimes despite the absence of the weak nuclear interaction.
Fred Adams's 2008 stellar models assume the existence of stable nuclei rather than calculating nuclear stability across alternative fundamental constants.
Virtue theories define compassion and courage as dispositions to act that require a lifetime of choices to be exercised.
Theistic conceptions of the afterlife hold that human souls persist after bodily death and can develop morally in a post-mortem existence.
Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan, developed by Donald Trump and opened in 1983, generated substantial condominium and commercial rental income for decades afterward.
Forbes estimated in 2004 that Donald Trump's actual net worth was between $150 million and $250 million, far below his own claims at the time.
Arvind Borde, Alan Guth, and Alexander Vilenkin proved in 2003 that any universe with an average Hubble expansion rate greater than zero cannot be past-eternal.
The Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem's finite affine length conclusion relies on classical general relativity without incorporating quantum gravitational effects near the initial singularity.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment includes tasks testing memory, attention, language, and executive function rather than only basic orientation.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment is designed to screen for dementia and mild cognitive impairment rather than to measure general intelligence.
In rodent fear-conditioning experiments, enduring behavioral responses to painful stimuli arise through associative learning.
In Masserman’s 1964 experiment, rhesus monkeys previously exposed to electric shocks were more likely to forgo food to avoid shocking another monkey.
Engineers designing bridges rely on the constancy of gravitational and material properties to calculate load tolerances before construction begins.

Localized suspensions of physical regularities (miracles) would remain undetectable to human observers as violations if they occur in low-observation contexts such as animal suffering in remote wilderness.
UNICEF estimated that children accounted for roughly one-third of the fatalities from the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
Irreversible loss of all brain function eliminates the neurological capacities for learning in human infants and nonhuman animals.
An animal’s persistence in protecting offspring despite fear during a fatal natural disaster constitutes an exercise of courage before death.
Sarasota Bay bottlenose dolphins responded more strongly to synthetic signature whistles of close relatives than familiar unrelated dolphins in playback experiments.
The 2013 Sarasota Bay whistle-copying study did not experimentally distinguish individual-directed addressing from vocal matching during social contact.
The Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem’s derivation uses kinematics without assuming Einstein’s field equations or energy conditions.
Human agency in planning actions depends on predictability of physical laws in the immediate environment, not on the causal mechanisms of distant natural disasters and diseases.
The Trump Organization sold the lease for the Trump International Hotel in Washington, D.C., for $375 million in 2022.
Donald Trump received at least $413 million in 2018 dollars from Fred Trump's empire, according to The New York Times’s 2018 investigation.
The White House’s January 16, 2018, press-briefing transcript records Ronny Jackson announcing a perfect cognitive-assessment score for Donald Trump.
Ronny Jackson stated in a January 2018 White House press briefing that he personally administered the Montreal Cognitive Assessment to Donald Trump.
The White House physician's office reported the MoCA results in a press briefing rather than releasing the original test administration record.
The triple-alpha process, which produces carbon in stars, relies on a resonance in the carbon-12 nucleus at an energy level close to the combined energy of three helium-4 nuclei.
Fred Hoyle's 1953 prediction of a carbon-12 resonance was later found to hold across a range of stated shifts in the strong nuclear force, not only near zero percent.
Human motor learning uses repeated sensory feedback to refine predictions of the physical consequences of future movements.
In chaotic physical systems, initial measurement uncertainties grow exponentially over characteristic timescales despite unchanging governing laws.
Anthropologist Donald Brown's cross-cultural survey of human universals lists prohibitions on murder and rules of reciprocity as present in every documented society he examined.

Anthropologists documented societies, including Nazi Germany's SS and 19th-century slaveholding communities in the American South, whose codes of duty explicitly permitted the killing or ownership of members of designated outgroups.
Alexander Vilenkin and other physicists have stated that the Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem does not itself establish that the universe had a beginning in time.
The value of the gravitational fine-structure constant permits stars to burn steadily for billions of years rather than collapsing or dispersing rapidly.
Anthropic reasoning implies observed physical constants must permit observers regardless of any underlying explanation for those constants.
In Feynman diagram calculations, virtual particles correspond to propagator terms in the mathematical expansion of scattering amplitudes rather than particles crossing a detector.
Spontaneous parametric down-conversion experiments produce photon pairs from the quantum vacuum that are directly detected by physical photodetectors.
Subjecting children and animals to severe preventable suffering for other people's benefit violates the moral principle against treating sentient beings merely as means.
The time evolution of a quantum system's wave function follows the Schrödinger equation with no random terms in its formulation.
In the many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics, the Schrödinger equation describes only the deterministic evolution of the universal wavefunction, not individual particle outcomes.
Stellar-evolution calculations by Oberhummer, Csótó, and Schlattl found orders-of-magnitude reductions in carbon or oxygen yields after 0.5% changes in nucleon–nucleon interaction strength.
Published stellar models with stable beryllium-8 produce carbon through sequential two-body fusion reactions without relying on the triple-alpha resonance.
The Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem derives past geodesic incompleteness from kinematics without assuming Einstein’s field equations or any energy condition.
The positively expanding flat patch of de Sitter spacetime embeds in a geodesically complete spacetime extending infinitely into the past.
Deliberately inflicting severe suffering on children solely for amusement is morally wrong regardless of the perpetrator’s culture or community’s approval.
Cross-cultural agreement about moral duties does not logically entail the existence of moral obligations independent of human attitudes.
The virtual-photon propagator in quantum electrodynamics depends on the choice of gauge.
Kantian ethics holds that rational moral principles apply to the treatment of any sentient being regardless of the beneficiary of the harm.
The Kantian means-end principle governs the actions of rational moral agents toward other rational agents rather than the causal outcomes of impersonal natural processes.
Zero-metallicity stellar models produce stable hydrogen-burning stars without carbon or oxygen in the initial gas.
Hilbert's Hotel thought experiment illustrates that treating an actual infinite as a completed totality reached by adding one member at a time produces self-contradictory results.
Cantor's transfinite set theory treats actual infinities as completed mathematical objects with a consistent cardinal arithmetic, not as products of successive addition.
Neurologist Michael Persinger's experiments with weak magnetic fields applied to the temporal lobes induced sensed-presence experiences in a majority of test subjects.

Attempts to replicate Michael Persinger's 'God helmet' temporal-lobe stimulation experiments at Laurentian University failed to reproduce reported mystical effects when conducted by independent researchers in Sweden in 2004.
In free quantum field theory, vacuum two-point correlation functions are uniquely determined by the specified Hamiltonian and vacuum state.
Relativistic objective-collapse models prescribe stochastic evolution of quantum-field states even between measurements.
Hidden-variable interpretations of quantum mechanics, such as Bohmian mechanics, reproduce all quantum predictions using fully deterministic underlying variables.
Alexander Vilenkin, Arvind Borde, and Alan Guth published a peer-reviewed proof of the theorem in Physical Review Letters in 2003.
The Borde-Guth-Vilenkin theorem's authors, including Alexander Vilenkin, state that the theorem allows past-eternal cosmological models with an average expansion rate at or below zero.
The 1935 Nuremberg Laws in Nazi Germany legally stripped Jewish citizens of rights and permitted their persecution as a matter of state and social duty.

Members of the SS internal codes and slaveholding communities restricted their permitted killing or ownership to designated outgroups rather than to fellow group members, indicating an underlying in-group duty not to kill or own group members.
A gravitational coupling constant many orders of magnitude stronger than its actual value would cause stars to exhaust their fuel within millions rather than billions of years.
Stellar structure calculations show that gravitational strength could vary by more than an order of magnitude while still permitting stars with multi-billion-year hydrogen-burning lifetimes.
Removing predation and pathogenic mortality for juvenile animals would collapse population regulation mechanisms that determine species survival in existing ecosystems.
An omnipotent God has the power to preserve meaningful human agency through predictable natural laws without imposing severe suffering on children or animals.
The doctrine of double effect distinguishes foreseeable suffering permitted as a side effect from suffering used as a means to benefit others.
In standard set theory, the first infinite ordinal ω is a limit ordinal with no immediate predecessor.
Standard set theory defines the first infinite ordinal ω as the union of all finite ordinals generated by iterating the successor operation.
The Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem requires no energy condition on spacetime’s matter content.
The past geodesic incompleteness established by the Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem does not entail an absolute beginning of spacetime.
Mario Beauregard and Vincent Paquette’s 2006 fMRI study of 15 Carmelite nuns recorded right middle temporal cortex activation during recalled mystical experiences.
Mario Beauregard and Vincent Paquette’s 2006 fMRI study associated Carmelite nuns’ recalled mystical experiences with activity in brain regions outside the temporal lobes.
Pilot-wave quantum field theories in quantum equilibrium reproduce bosonic vacuum fluctuation statistics using deterministic field trajectories.
Heinrich Himmler's October 4, 1943, Posen speech characterized the extermination of Jews as a glorious chapter in SS history.
The Einstein static universe model of 1917 describes a spacetime with no beginning or ending time coordinate, extending eternally in both temporal directions.
Einstein's static universe model of 1917 is unstable to small perturbations in the density of matter.
Single stars exceeding 20 solar masses exhaust core hydrogen in less than 10 million years under the universe’s actual gravitational strength.
Video footage of the January 16, 2018 White House press briefing shows Ronny Jackson describing his administration of the cognitive test to Donald Trump.
Ronny Jackson's account of the January 2018 briefing was not independently corroborated by a contemporaneous video recording of the cognitive test itself.
Fred Adams' 2008 study found that only a narrow range of values for the strong nuclear force coupling constant, relative to gravity, permits stable stellar nucleosynthesis.
Fred Adams' 2008 study varies only two parameters, the fine structure constant and the strength of gravity, rather than the full set of fundamental constants.
Parasitic wasp larvae consume host caterpillars alive from the inside over several days before the caterpillar dies, a reproductive strategy occurring across thousands of wasp species.
Human epistemic limitations prevent finite observers from determining whether a morally sufficient reason exists for any particular instance of suffering.
Meaningful human choices between honesty and deception do not require natural hazards that kill young children or animals.
Predictability sufficient for informed human agency requires human access to the information needed to anticipate the consequences of available actions.
Multiple news outlets, including CNN and the Washington Post, published video footage of Ronny Jackson's January 16, 2018 press briefing stating Donald Trump scored 30 out of 30.

Multiple news transcripts of the January 16, 2018 White House press briefing quote Ronny Jackson describing Donald Trump's cognitive test result as '30 out of 30' rather than the official White House transcript itself.
Donald Brown's list of human universals includes incest avoidance and reciprocity norms among societies with no documented historical contact with one another.
Donald Brown's list of human universals defines murder as unlawful or unsanctioned killing, a category whose content varies by society's own legal and moral codes.
Along every comoving trajectory in the Einstein static universe, elapsed proper time equals elapsed cosmic time.
The official White House transcript of the January 16, 2018 briefing records Ronny Jackson identifying himself as the administrator of Donald Trump’s cognitive assessment.
Neuroimaging studies of Christian, Muslim, and Hindu contemplatives during reported mystical states record measurable changes in frontal and parietal lobe activity.
Neuroscientific studies using fMRI have found that mystical and unitive experiences correlate with identifiable patterns of brain activity in regions such as the parietal lobe.
Fred Adams’ 2008 stellar models require the minimum mass for nuclear ignition to remain below the maximum mass permitted by radiation-pressure stability.
Fred Adams’ 2008 study found that roughly one-quarter of the explored parameter space supports nuclear-burning stars.
The Einstein static universe metric contains a time coordinate defined over the entire real line from negative infinity to positive infinity.
At the April 23, 2020 White House briefing, Donald Trump specified medical doctors’ involvement immediately after discussing disinfectant use inside the body.
Steven Pinker’s The Blank Slate reproduces Donald Brown’s catalogue of human universals in an appendix.
Donald Brown’s catalogue of human universals lacks society-by-society documentation establishing the universality of murder prohibitions or reciprocity rules.

Walter Stace's 1960 comparative study of mystical reports across Christian, Muslim, and Hindu traditions identified a common core of features including ineffability, unity, and transcendence of time and space.

Scholars including Steven Katz in the 1978 volume Mysticism and Philosophical Analysis argued that reported mystical experiences are shaped and structured by each mystic's prior religious and cultural concepts.
Moral philosophers widely treat sentience, not rational agency, as the relevant criterion for the wrongness of instrumentalizing a being's suffering for another's benefit.
Cognitive science research finds that humans systematically underestimate the number of causal factors and long-term consequences connected to any single event.

Human epistemic limitations regarding a domain do not prevent finite observers from forming justified probabilistic judgments about that domain in fields such as forensic science and medical diagnosis.
Chapter 28 of Teresa of Ávila’s autobiography, The Life of Teresa of Jesus, records a first-person account of seeing Jesus Christ.
Domestic dogs that endure painful medical treatment or injury display increased affectionate bonding and protective behavior toward their caregivers afterward.
Fred Adams's 2008 paper 'Stars in Other Universes' varies the fine structure constant and gravitational constant while treating nuclear binding energies and stability as fixed input parameters.
Fred Adams's 2008 paper 'Stars in Other Universes' recalculates nuclear binding energy thresholds using varied values of the fine-structure and gravitational constants.
Six of Donald Trump's businesses, including Trump Taj Mahal and Trump Entertainment Resorts, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection between 1991 and 2009.
The inability of young children and animals to give informed consent imposes heightened protective duties on agents controlling exposure to serious harm.
Classical utilitarianism permits imposing suffering on innocent sentient beings when imposing suffering maximizes aggregate well-being.
The negative integers form an infinite ordered sequence with an immediate predecessor for every element and no first element.
Human observers lack empirical access to alternative possible worlds in which a particular instance of suffering is prevented.
Knowledge that torturing a child solely for amusement is morally wrong does not require exhaustive knowledge of the torture’s consequences.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment tests memory, language, attention and visuospatial skills used to detect mild cognitive impairment and dementia.
The Montreal Cognitive Assessment is designed to screen for dementia and mild cognitive impairment rather than to measure general intelligence.
Continental Army forces controlled colonial forts and ports during the Revolutionary War, which shared logistical functions with modern airports.
No independent medical professional besides Ronny Jackson has publicly confirmed administering or witnessing Donald Trump's 2018 Montreal Cognitive Assessment.
The Māṇḍūkya Upanishad and Plotinus’s Enneads VI.9 describe states of awareness lacking a distinction between experiencer and experienced.
The Sufi mystic Muhammad Ghawth incorporated Hindu yogic practices into his sixteenth-century Persian work Bahr al-Hayat.
Donald Trump won the 2024 general election against Kamala Harris, a sitting Vice President, while outperforming his 2016 and 2020 popular vote margins.
Hillary Clinton outspent Donald Trump's campaign in the 2016 general election.
The White House published an official transcript of the April 23, 2020 coronavirus task force briefing that recorded Trump's disinfectant remarks verbatim.
Fred Adams's 2008 stellar models parameterize nuclear energy generation using a composite reaction-rate coefficient rather than a nuclear structure calculation.
Hillary Clinton received nearly 2.9 million more votes nationwide than Donald Trump in the 2016 United States presidential election.
Donald Trump's 2019 speech referred to Continental Army forces 'protecting the airports' rather than 'taking over' them, according to some transcripts of the address.
Ronny Jackson's 2018 White House medical report on Donald Trump does not include the raw MoCA test document or scoring sheet.
Donald Trump lost the popular vote in the 2016 general election despite winning the Electoral College against Hillary Clinton.
Hillary Clinton received nearly 2.9 million more popular votes than Donald Trump in the 2016 United States presidential election.
Ronny Jackson publicly disclosed Donald Trump’s cognitive screening results during a televised White House press briefing in January 2018.
